pipelines.name: ci

steps.name: ci/check-diff-on-generated-manifest-files
steps.run: git --no-pager diff --exit-code *manifest.* || (echo "Please run \"make apply\" and commit the changes in the generated manifests." && exit 1)

steps.name: ci/check-diff-on-webapp-i18n-files
steps.run: git --no-pager diff --exit-code webapp/i18n/en.json || (echo "Please run \"make i18n-extract\" and commit the changes in webapp/i18n/en.json." && exit 1)

steps.name: ci/check-diff-on-webapp-graphql-generated-files
steps.run: git --no-pager diff --exit-code webapp/src/graphql/generated/ || (echo "Please run \"make graphql\" and commit the changes." && exit 1)

steps.name: ci/check-source-plugin-manifest-version
steps.run:
# plugin.json must omit "version"; build tooling derives it from git tags/commits for release bundles.
make manifest-check

steps.name: ci/check-diff-on-gomod
steps.run: git --no-pager diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum || (echo "Please run \"go mod tidy\" and commit the changes in go.mod and go.sum." && exit 1)

steps.name: ci/lint-aggregator
steps.run:
echo "lint-go=$LINT_GO_RESULT lint-web=$LINT_WEB_RESULT"
if [ "$LINT_GO_RESULT" != "success" ] || [ "$LINT_WEB_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
  echo "One or more upstream lint jobs did not succeed."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Upload dist to S3
steps.run: aws s3 cp dist/playbooks-*.tar.gz s3://${{ secrets.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/mattermost-plugin-playbooks/mattermost-plugin-playbooks-${{ steps.short-sha.outputs.sha }}.tar.gz

steps.name: Upload dist-fips to S3
steps.run: aws s3 cp dist-fips/playbooks-*.tar.gz s3://${{ secrets.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/mattermost-plugin-playbooks/mattermost-plugin-playbooks-fips-${{ steps.short-sha.outputs.sha }}.tar.gz
